claim_summary: Selected trained mice make stimulus-guided choices in this motion task
limitation: Conclusions condition on retained sessions and response eligibility
requested_action: Describe the selected population and filtering explicitly

claim_summary: Control choice and RT distributions favor accumulation over the matched nonintegration candidates within the tested recovery range
limitation: RTs supply most of the advantage and recovery uses fixed fitted parameter ranges
requested_action: Keep matched comparison and completed paired recovery in the main paper

claim_summary: Randomized scheduled pulse direction changes directional responses within the retained session population
limitation: State the outcome and selected-session population and do not transfer causality to RT-conditioned bins
requested_action: Use signed scheduled-pulse contrast as the primary perturbation result

claim_summary: Post-pulse response-conditioned influence provides an exact intrinsic forgetting time
limitation: A no-leak bounded model also produces a late decline in the same readout
requested_action: Describe the observed interval and forward-model constraints without inferring an intrinsic cutoff

claim_summary: Every tested accumulator fails the cohort-average pulse amplitude
limitation: Several model means and some no-sv summaries lie within data intervals
requested_action: Show individual timing and heterogeneity instead of claiming universal mean-amplitude failure

claim_summary: Persistent additive drift variability can generate the late reversal within the tested simulation pipeline
limitation: This is a model-level counterfactual not proof of biological absence of drift variation
requested_action: Show matched ablations and keep computational and biological interpretations separate

claim_summary: Persistent drift variability is required by the RT distributions of every mouse
limitation: One matched score gap is dominated by PSUIM7 and smaller-mouse differences can be simulation-noise limited
requested_action: Display every mouse and retain the dominant-mouse sensitivity

claim_summary: Choice states identify an attention mechanism explaining pulse and RT behavior
limitation: Choice prediction improves but RT validation and state-specific pulse benefit are inconsistent
requested_action: Keep state analyses as supporting diagnostics and do not label attention

claim_summary: Positive sensory gain has been validated as the source of decision variability
limitation: Two full-training local pilots partly improve the late tradeoff but miss early effects and lack held-out model ranking
requested_action: Report as exploratory feasibility and avoid a resolved-mechanism headline

claim_summary: The present fit failures prove that the full behavioral dataset cannot identify an accumulation mechanism
limitation: Failure of specified fitted models differs from structural nonidentifiability of all candidate mechanisms
requested_action: Bound the claim to tested accounts and particular readout ambiguity

claim_summary: A late decrease in the dilution-adjusted pulse readout alone does not establish leakage
limitation: This constructive counterexample does not show equivalence for every quantitative feature
requested_action: Use the same estimator on data and no-leak predictions to show the interpretive limit

claim_summary: The cohort establishes a robust early greater than middle greater than late evidence weighting
limitation: Onset comparisons are uncertain and late-stage mice differ from early-middle cohorts
requested_action: Keep onset analyses qualified and avoid a cohort primacy claim

claim_summary: Pulses place additional quantitative constraints on accumulation accounts favored by control choice and RT fits
limitation: The exact mechanism and calibrated class-wide rejection remain unresolved
requested_action: Build the accumulation-first paper around matched predictive checks
